articles.title: Strategy, Strive face balancing act between bitcoin buying and preferred stock dividends
articles.snippet: The securities have financed purchases of nearly 136,000 bitcoin, opening a funding channel that analysts expect to complement the larger ETF market.

articles.title: Block's new voice AI sounds eerily human, sparking awe and scam fears
articles.snippet: Reactions split between amazement at how human it sounds and fears it could fuel scams and deception, with CZ eyeing uses in children’s education.

articles.title: Why McDonalds, Microsoft and Google saying no to tokenized stocks isn't a dealbreaker
articles.snippet: Some of the world's biggest companies objected to being listed on the first tokenized securities trading venue under the SEC's innovation exemption. But the early pushback may say more about issuer caution than about rejection of tokenization itself.

articles.title: Argentina drops criminal probe into President Milei over crashed memecoin LIBRA
articles.snippet: The judge found that Milei's promotion of LIBRA did not constitute fraud, despite the attention his support drew to the token.

articles.title: Wells Fargo, Cisco, Marvell among latest firms objecting to OKXICE's tokenized stock plan
articles.snippet: Six more companies have objected to listing tokenized versions of their stock on the venue, Reuters reported, bringing the total to 22.
